name: Decision-1
description: Microsoft Decision-1 is a text decision model from Microsoft AI for classification, routing, and evaluation. It answers yes/no questions, selects among predefined options, and scores inputs against custom criteria, returning calibrated probabilities and confidence values. With support for multiple questions per request and a 32,768-token context window, it helps developers triage support requests, guide automated workflows, and evaluate AI responses against a rubric.
